keyFindings.description: MentionAttemptStandsSQL (model.go:1325-1327) treats every later failed attempt as having delivered nothing, but a receipt timeout is recorded failed while 'the message may already have been delivered' (envoy_resolve.go:154-159, contracts/generated.go:153), and a reply-callback error can fail an attempt the session received. A Retry in another mode that lands and times out leaves attempt 1 standing; the lane (comment_delivery.go:307-310) or the sweep sends it under its own mode's key, so the session gets two frames the listener and host cannot dedupe. Reproduced. Round 7's build superseded attempt 1 here (one copy). Fix: send an attempt that stands only because later attempts failed under the latest failed later attempt's mode and key (as the outbox's fallback copy already does), or let only a provably undelivered failure make it stand; add the reproduction as a test; correct 'a failed Retry delivers nothing' (model.go:1317-1319, comment_delivery.go:241-243 and 664-666, the changelog).

An attempt overtaken by a delivered one stays pending for good when supersedeOvertakenAttempts errors (:645-649 says the next bound sender settles it; after a stand-down none is bound, the sweep owes only standing attempts, and the outbox never reads the key abandoned beside a sent attempt), and also when a reply flips a stood-down Retry's attempt to sent (:1074-1077). The card shows it pending indefinitely. Let the sweep settle pending, claim-free attempts that MentionAttemptDeliveredLaterSQL covers, and drop the error branch.

Docs the stand-down state makes false: model.go:1388-1389 (MentionAbandonedSQL 'the delivery sweep will never send') and delivery_sweep.go:85-88 ('every attempt that may yet be sent'): a stood-down attempt reads abandoned while its Retry is in flight and is owed once it fails; model.go:1320-1321 names the wrong predicate. Hardening: a second card Retry while the first is in flight resumes the stood-down attempt 1 in its pinned mode (:317-331).
